chapters.title: Approve the payments cutover on {{migration.payments_cutover|date}}
chapters.dek: It leaves {{migration.cutover_to_freeze_days}} of normal traffic before the freeze starts.
chapters.notes: Open with the ask. The cutover window closes when the freeze begins; after that, payments waits until December.

chapters.title: Traffic moved service by service, with no big-bang weekend
chapters.notes: Each step up is one service going live. The dip in November is the peak-season freeze.

blocks.text: Catalog moved on {{migration.catalog_live|date}}, cart on {{migration.cart_live|date}} and checkout on {{migration.checkout_live|date}}. Payments is next; fulfillment follows by {{migration.fulfillment_target|date}}.

chapters.title: Every change takes the same short path to production
chapters.notes: Click through the animation one step at a time; each step is one stage of the pipeline.

blocks.alt: A change passes CI and one review, waits in the merge queue, then reaches production through a canary.

chapters.title: Running two platforms costs {{cost.dual_run}} a month until the monolith retires
chapters.notes: The dual-run cost ends when fulfillment moves and the monolith licence lapses.
